title: I Used the Hallway Camera on the Neighbor Who Took My Labeled Umbrella

parts.text: I set the stand at 7:48 a.m. with a tagged black umbrella and came back to an empty hook. Neighbor Pru called umbrellas communal. I was forty-one, tenant, holding the tag photo. I used the hallway camera still that showed Pru's sleeve on my tag. Management pinged the still. The umbrella returned with an apology sticky. Pru brings a personal hook. The stand finally looks like a tag, not a pool. I kept the still in a folder labeled BORING.

social.video_title: The hallway camera caught the labeled umbrella leaving — Part 1/1
social.description: Tagged hook, an empty stand, a sleeve on camera. Would you have asked management for the still?
